user_story:
As a user, I want to navigate to the HTTP status code pages so that I can learn about different HTTP status codes.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. I can click on the link with text '200' and be redirected to the URL 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/status_codes/200'.
2. I can click on the link with text '301' and be redirected to the URL 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/status_codes/301'.
3. I can click on the link with text '404' and be redirected to the URL 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/status_codes/404'.
4. I can click on the link with text '500' and be redirected to the URL 'https://the-internet.herokuapp.com/status_codes/500'.
5. The page contains a div with id 'flash-messages', class 'large-12 columns'.
6. The page contains a div with id 'content', class 'large-12 columns', and text 'Status Codes HTTP status codes are a standard set of numbers'.
